title: Customer portal ON lets the user manage the customer portal
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with the Customer portal toggle (under Page Access) ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open Customer portal.
  2. Change a portal setting.
  3. Save.
custom_expected:
Customer portal can be opened and edited.

The saved change sticks.
